source_name: Invest North Macedonia — Useful links (business associations index)
why_relevant: Government investment-agency curated index of chambers, associations and business bodies — a low-cost way to discover association bodies missed by keyword search, and semi-authoritative on which associations the state recognises as counterparties.

source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — national e-services catalogue entry for Централен регистар / Службен весник
why_relevant: Government service catalogue enumerating every CRM service with its formal name, fee and delivery channel. Efficient way to discover registry products (extracts, certificates, data services) that are not obvious from the CRM site navigation.

source_name: НБРСМ — Регистар на оператори на платните системи (Register of payment system operators)
why_relevant: Identifies the licensed operators of MK payment systems (KIBS clearing, CaSys card scheme/switch, NBRSM MIPS) — the core infrastructure employers in this cell.

source_name: МБ — издавачи на задолжителна котација (список на котирани банки)
why_relevant: Canonical actor map for this cell: identifies exactly which banks carry SEI-NET disclosure obligations. Fetched listing shows 7 banks — Комерцијална банка (KMB), АЛТА банка АД Битола (ex-Стопанска банка Битола), ТТК Банка, НЛБ Банка, Стопанска банка АД Скопје, УНИ Банка, Централна кооперативна банка — each with an issuer page and website.

source_name: Центар за граѓански комуникации (Center for Civil Communications, CCC) — public procurement monitoring
why_relevant: The long-running independent monitor of MK public procurement. Its semi-annual monitoring reports, municipal procurement database and case studies identify concentrated suppliers, single-bidder procedures and confidential contracts — an analytical pointer that tells you which suppliers and which buying units to track in ESJN, and which contracts were deliberately hidden.

source_name: MASIT — Members directory (per-company pages)
why_relevant: One structured page per member company under a predictable /en/members-en/{slug}/ pattern — the canonical enumeration of MK ICT vendors, including payments-relevant members observed such as KIBS AD Skopje (the interbank clearing house), Finelevate, Nextsense, Bransys, Innox, CMX Solutions, Insight Group, Valtech, Factum, Deltatre and KabTel. This directory is the population map every vendor-side hiring and org-change cell should monitor.

source_name: MASIT — Chamber of Commerce for ICT, member directory (Стопанска комора за информатички и комуникациски технологии)
why_relevant: Single richest actor-map pointer for the MK IT supplier ecosystem: ~160+ member companies each with a profile page carrying self-description of sectors served, including banking/fintech. This is how you enumerate integrators you have not yet heard of, in both MK and EN mirrors of the same directory.

source_name: ССМ — Сојуз на синдикатите на Македонија, грански синдикати
why_relevant: National confederation; its branch-union index is the authoritative pointer to which sector union covers financial-services workers and how it is named, plus links to each affiliate's own channel. Confederation news also carries general collective agreement (Општ колективен договор за стопанството) rounds that bind bank employers.

source_name: MBA — Собрание, Комисии и SKIBOR панел (working bodies)
why_relevant: The association's About/Activities structure enumerates the Assembly, standing Commissions (комисии) and the SKIBOR panel. Commission chairs and SKIBOR panel banks are the sub-institutional map of which bank executives hold payments/risk/ESG weight; commission composition also enumerates the member population. Membership per the About page = all banks and savings houses licensed under the Law on Banks, plus KIBS AD Skopje (clearing house) and Macedonian Credit Bureau AD Skopje — i.e. an implicit but authoritative member roster.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија — здруженија и групации index
why_relevant: The Chamber organises members into ~15 Associations, ~12 Асоцијации and ~38 Групации, each with a named president, vice-presidents and a Chamber secretary. It is the single richest enumeration of which companies operate in a given sector in MK, and the elected chairs are leadership signals. The ICT Association page currently names Blagoj Hristov (Makedonski Telekom) as president with Valentina Taseva (Semos Education) and Aneta Antova Pesheva (Ultra) as vice-presidents.

source_name: Стопанска комора — Групација на небанкарски финансиски друштва
why_relevant: Enumerates the non-bank financial population — financial companies, leasing, pension companies, insurers, card processors — with an elected chair (reported as Nikola Joshevski, GM/partner at SN Finance). Named participants observed include Tigo Finance, Osiguruvanje Makedonija (VIG), KB Prvo pension company, Croatia Osiguruvanje-Zivot, Sparkasse Leasing, Euroins, and Casys (International Card System). Casys is a payments processor, making this group directly on-scope for payments-sector actor mapping.

source_name: AmCham North Macedonia — Members List
why_relevant: Over 130 member organisations across five tiers (Patron, Corporate, Business, Entrepreneur, NGO), including major foreign investors and banks. Tier is itself a proxy for institutional weight, and the roster enumerates foreign-owned financial actors that other cells must monitor.

source_name: AmCham North Macedonia — member directory (payments/banking members)
why_relevant: Chamber member profiles carry current company contacts and representative names; useful for building and refreshing the actor map behind LinkedIn identities, and events pages reveal who currently represents each institution.

source_name: Slobodenpristap.mk / АСПИ — FOI request platform and register of information holders
why_relevant: Fallback route when a contract, award file or the contracting authority's staffing is not published: FOI requests to the named holder (e.g. DKZJN, MoF) are filed and answered in public, and the ASPI register lists every institution's information officer — itself a named-contact dataset for buying units.

source_name: zk.mk — business directory category 'Банкарски Системи' (banking systems suppliers)
why_relevant: MK-language commercial directory with a dedicated 'Банкарски Системи' and 'Електронско Банкарство' category — a ready-made, local-language enumeration of firms that sell banking/e-banking systems in MK, including small local players invisible to English search. Ideal seed list for snowballing to vendor sites.

source_name: zk.mk directory — Employment agencies (recruitment & staffing) in Skopje
why_relevant: Local business directory category that enumerates the full population of Skopje staffing/recruitment agencies — the cheapest way to complete the recruiter actor map for this cell rather than discovering firms one search at a time.

source_name: Википедија (mk/en) — Народна банка на Македонија / Комисија за хартии од вредност
why_relevant: Not authoritative, but an excellent actor-map and succession-list scaffold (historical governors, legal appointment mechanics, article references to the Law on the NBRM) and a source of citation links back to primary acts.

source_name: Wikipedia (en + mk) — MK bank and NBRNM articles as pointer/date-anchor
why_relevant: Not a citable source for a personnel fact, but its revision history is a de-facto archive: edits to a bank's or the central bank's infobox ('Governor', 'CEO') timestamp when a change became public, and the cited references point straight to the primary announcement. Also gives biographies of central-bank leadership (e.g. Anita Angelovska-Bezhoska) and the canonical entity list.

entity_name: Ahrefs competitor profiles for MK job-board domains
source_name: Ahrefs competitor profiles for MK job-board domains
why_relevant: Pure pointer/discovery utility: the competitor lists for vrabotuvanje.com.mk, kariera.mk, apliciraj.mk and av.gov.mk enumerate the full MK job-board long tail by traffic, which is the cheapest way to close recall gaps in this cell and to detect a new board entering the market. Not a content source.

source_name: CFA Institute — 'Find a CFA Society' directory
why_relevant: Authoritative directory to determine whether a CFA Society exists for North Macedonia or whether MK charterholders affiliate to a neighbouring society (e.g. CFA Society Greece, which runs certificates/courses for the region). Determines where MK investment/treasury professionals surface publicly.

entity_name: IMF/World Bank Financial Sector Assessment Program
source_name: IMF/World Bank Financial Sector Assessment Program (FSAP) — North Macedonia
why_relevant: FSAP assessments (MK: 2003, 2008, 2018 cycle) grade Basel Core Principle compliance including 'fit and proper' licensing of bank directors and senior management, board independence and supervisory staffing adequacy — the international benchmark that dates governance/organisational reforms.

source_name: InHunt World — North Macedonia headhunting partner page
why_relevant: Global executive-search network page that names its MK member firm — a pointer for discovering the local headhunters that international banking groups use when hiring into Skopje.

source_name: Licentium — North Macedonia licensing hub (PSP/EMI licence tracker)
why_relevant: Third-party consolidation of MK payment/EMI licensing requirements and licensed-entity context; useful pointer when the NBRSM site is bot-blocked.

source_name: paytech.events — Fintech, Banking & Payments conference calendar
why_relevant: Aggregator calendar of banking/payments conferences; used to discover which regional events MK institutions attend or sponsor, and to enumerate new event sites for speaker-list harvesting. Pure pointer value, no MK-specific content of its own.

entity_name: Temenos global offices and partner directory
source_name: Temenos global offices and partner directory
why_relevant: Core-banking vendor whose MK footprint runs through partners/implementers rather than a country office; the offices and partner directory pages reveal which regional entity and which SI partner owns MK accounts, an indirect route to the relevant hires.

source_name: US Commercial Service — North Macedonia Principal Business Associations
why_relevant: An externally compiled enumeration of the principal MK business associations with contact details — valuable as a cross-check that the association universe assembled from local search is complete, and as a historical snapshot. Hosted on a legacy/archived US government domain, so treat currency as low.

source_name: Western Union Macedonia market site
why_relevant: Confirms WU's active MK market presence and names local agent/bank partners; the partner and country-page structure is the entry point for identifying who manages the MK corridor, given no MK-specific WU appointment news was found.

source_name: Германо-Македонска стопанска комора (AHK Nordmazedonien)
why_relevant: Bilateral chamber (German AHK network) with its own member roster and board; German-owned or German-serving financial and IT firms in MK appear here. AHK chambers typically publish a member directory and an elected board, and their event programmes reveal which executives currently front the payments/finance agenda.

entity_name: Стопанска комора на северо-западна Македонија / Oda Ekonomike e Maqedonisë Veriperëndimore
source_name: Стопанска комора на северо-западна Македонија / Oda Ekonomike e Maqedonisë Veriperëndimore (OEMVP)
why_relevant: The second major general chamber in MK, operating in Albanian and Macedonian, with its own elected leadership and member base. Necessary to avoid an Albanian-language blind spot in the actor map — several MK banks and financial companies have Albanian-language business communities that the Skopje chamber under-represents.
